title: Privacy Policy
description: Privacy policy and data collection transparency for Get Eco Driver (getecodriver.com).
contentHtml:
Last updated: November 4, 2026

This Privacy Policy describes how Get Eco Driver ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and safeguards information when you visit getecodriver.com.

1. Information We Collect

We believe in high-performance, lightweight web architecture. We do not require account registration or retain personal identifiable information (PII) beyond standard server logs and analytics.

  • Log Files: Standard web server logs collect non-identifiable technical data including IP addresses, browser types, internet service providers (ISPs), referring/exit pages, and timestamps.
  • Cookies and Web Beacons: We may use minimal technical cookies to store visitor preferences and optimize user experience across sessions.

2. Third-Party Partners & Advertising

Third-party advertising partners, including Google AdSense, may place cookies on your browser to serve contextual advertisements based on prior visits. Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings.

3. Affiliate Disclosure

Get Eco Driver participates in affiliate marketing programs, including the Amazon Services LLC Associates Program. As an Amazon Associate, we earn from qualifying purchases made through links on our site at no additional cost to you.

4. Data Security

We implement strict SSL encryption across getecodriver.com. Our static site architecture eliminates backend SQL databases, significantly reducing data breach vulnerabilities.

5. Contact Information

For inquiries regarding this privacy policy, please contact privacy@getecodriver.com.
